Opened a PR to fix this: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pull/2689 

Personally, I think we should push for 128 bit, which is covered by NIST just not as a minimum requirement. If the rest of the ASVS standard for crypto indicates 128-bit then I think bringing the appendix inline is a good thing. 

Either way, there's a PR so we can choose either/or as the discussion progresses. M.
